abstract: As reported here, this study retrospectively examined the usefulness of therapy including lentinan in patients with unresectable advanced gastric cancer. 20 Nakao H, Namatame K, Nemoto H, Motohashi H, Nishiyama K and Kumada K: A multi-institutional prospective study of lentinan in advanced gastric cancer patients with unresectable and recurrent diseases: Effect on prolongation of survival and improvement of quality of life. 21 Ochiai T, Isono K, Suzuki T, Koide Y, Gunji Y, Nagata M and Ogawa N: Effect of immunotherapy with lentinan on patients’ survival and immunological parameters in patients with advanced gastric cancer: Results of a multicentre randomized controlled study.
